alert.raw_text: User clicked link in email from spoofed-hr@company-benefits.xyz claiming to require immediate password reset. Link redirects to credential harvesting page mimicking company SSO portal.

expected.reasoning: Spoofed sender with credential harvesting link targeting employee via fake SSO portal

alert.raw_text: Bulk phishing campaign detected: 200+ employees received identical email impersonating IT department requesting MFA token reset via malicious link.

expected.reasoning: Large-scale phishing campaign targeting 200+ employees with MFA bypass attempt

alert.raw_text: CEO impersonation email sent to CFO requesting urgent wire transfer of $285,000 to new vendor account. Email passed SPF but failed DKIM. Reply-to address differs from sender.

expected.reasoning: Business email compromise targeting CFO with fraudulent wire transfer request impersonating CEO

alert.raw_text: 47 failed SSH login attempts from IP 198.51.100.23 targeting root account over 12-minute window. IP geolocated to known VPS hosting provider.

expected.reasoning: Moderate-volume SSH brute force from VPS targeting root account

alert.raw_text: Automated credential stuffing attack against customer login portal. 12,000 unique username/password combinations attempted from rotating proxy IPs in 30-minute window.

expected.reasoning: Large-scale credential stuffing with 12K attempts from rotating proxies targeting customer portal

alert.raw_text: Employee uploaded 340MB archive containing customer PII to personal Google Drive. File includes SSN and credit card fields from CRM export.

expected.reasoning: Large-volume PII exfiltration including SSN and credit card data to personal cloud storage

alert.raw_text: Unusual S3 bucket access: 2.1GB of customer data downloaded via API from IP not associated with any known employee or service. Bucket contains billing records.

expected.reasoning: Unauthorized bulk download of customer billing data from unknown IP address

alert.raw_text: DNS exfiltration detected: workstation making thousands of DNS queries to subdomain.evil-dns.com with encoded data in subdomain labels. Queries average 200 bytes of data each.

expected.reasoning: Active DNS tunneling exfiltration channel with encoded data to known malicious domain

alert.raw_text: Service account credentials found in public GitHub repository. Account has read access to production Cloud SQL database containing customer records.

expected.reasoning: Exposed service account credentials with production database access in public repository

alert.raw_text: Admin account logged in from two countries within 15 minutes: New York (US) and Lagos (NG). Impossible travel detected. Session from Lagos changed 3 user permissions.

expected.reasoning: Impossible travel on admin account with permission changes from suspicious location

alert.raw_text: Employee on performance improvement plan accessed confidential M&A documents and board meeting minutes 47 times in past 24 hours, outside normal access patterns.

expected.reasoning: At-risk employee exhibiting anomalous access to highly sensitive M&A documents

alert.raw_text: Recently terminated employee's VPN credentials used to access internal file server 6 hours after account should have been disabled. Downloaded engineering design documents.

expected.reasoning: Terminated employee accessing systems post-termination and downloading proprietary documents

alert.raw_text: Executable dropper detected on workstation. Process spawned PowerShell with encoded command downloading payload from known C2 domain evil-update.xyz.

expected.reasoning: Active malware dropper with C2 communication and payload download on finance workstation

alert.raw_text: Ransomware behavior detected: rapid file encryption across network shares. 450 files encrypted with .locked extension in 3 minutes. Process originated from email attachment.

expected.reasoning: Active ransomware encrypting network shares, immediate containment required

alert.raw_text: Cryptominer process detected on development server. CPU usage spiked to 95% running xmrig binary. Process was installed via compromised npm package in CI pipeline.

expected.reasoning: Cryptominer installed via supply chain compromise in CI pipeline npm package
